name: organ-brightness-sweep
summary: Tone opens the upper harmonics one after the other; body is the level; modulation flips the rotary; effects add overdrive.

name: organ-full-to-flute
summary: Tone crossfades from a full registration to a flute-like one.

name: organ-gospel-swell
summary: Body swells the low drawbars together; tone drives overdrive and brightness; effects add leakage.

name: organ-jazz-percussive
summary: A clean, percussive jazz sound: click and the 4' drawbar come in with the tone axis.

name: organ-rock-grit
summary: Overdrive and the dry mix move in opposite directions so the grit grows without losing the attack.

name: organ-rotary-morph
summary: All four axes shape the rotary speaker instead of the tone.

name: organ-click-and-air
summary: Mechanical character of the organ: key clicks and leakage.

name: organ-eq-tilt
summary: Tone tilts the organ's EQ between dark and bright.

name: organ-lower-swell
summary: Shapes the lower manual's drawbars; for a bass or comping part on the lower keyboard.

name: organ-pipe-registration
summary: A pipe-organ build-up: foundation fixed by the patch, mixtures come in over the tone axis.

name: organ-ballad-warm
summary: A warm ballad sound: the tone axis darkens the EQ while the low drawbars rise.

name: organ-dynamic-volume
summary: The body axis is an organ volume pedal.

name: synth-lead-expressive
summary: Cutoff and resonance open together; vibrato grows with the modulation axis.

name: synth-lead-bite
summary: A biting lead: resonance on the body axis, cutoff on the tone axis.

name: synth-lead-solo-glide
summary: For a mono lead with portamento on: glide time and vibrato are under the fingers.

name: synth-pad-evolve
summary: A slow pad: attack and cutoff evolve; the effects axis opens reverb and release.

name: synth-pad-breath
summary: Breathing pad: envelope times on the body and effects axes, filter movement on the tone axis.

name: synth-pad-ambient
summary: Wide and washed: effects dominate.

name: synth-bass-punch
summary: A punchy bass: cutoff and resonance on tone, decay on body.

name: synth-bass-growl
summary: Resonance does the growling; attack is shortened as the tone opens.

name: synth-brass-swell
summary: A brass swell: attack lengthens while the filter opens.

name: synth-strings-ensemble
summary: String sections: slow attack, chorus on the effects axis, vibrato on the modulation axis.

name: synth-keys-electric
summary: Electric-piano-like synth keys: decay on body, tremolo-ish vibrato, reverb.

name: synth-pluck
summary: Plucked sounds: decay and release are short and shaped together.

name: synth-filter-only
summary: The simplest synth template: cutoff, resonance, reverb and vibrato, one each.

name: synth-lower-layer
summary: Same ideas as synth-filter-only, but on the lower synth part.

name: piano-concert
summary: A concert piano: expression on body, reverb on effects, chorus kept subtle.

name: piano-ambient
summary: A cinematic piano: reverb and chorus open together.

name: piano-ep-chorus
summary: An electric piano with chorus on the tone axis.

name: piano-intimate
summary: A dry, close piano: almost no effects, just expression and a little width.

name: xfade-piano-synth
summary: Crossfade the upper piano into the upper synth.

name: xfade-upper-lower
summary: Crossfade between the upper and lower synth parts.

name: xfade-organ-synth
summary: Crossfade the organ into the upper synth.

name: xfade-piano-organ
summary: Crossfade the upper piano into the organ.

name: perform-expression-reverb
summary: A neutral performance template: overall volume, reverb and chorus sends.

name: perform-width
summary: Stereo width: pan and chorus on the sides, reverb at the back.
